name: generic H4.5 P1.0 W0.5
purpose: Tune the generic footprint's antenna inside its fixed 12 x 5 mm keep-out (antenna.GENERIC_KEEPOUT) on a synthetic 30 mm disc (2 layers 1.0 mm, CR1632 under the board, keep-out centred at the top): meander length n to 2.465 GHz and S towards 50 ohm, then compare the variants by matched bandwidth with an L network and efficiency. Variant: the generic start copper.
